panels.title: L1 head block
panels.description: geth execution head gauge (chain_head_block via /debug/metrics/prometheus). Metric names in this dashboard are the expected geth exposition names; they get finalized from the live scrape of this stand.

panels.title: Execution peers
panels.description: geth p2p peer count (p2p_peers). On this single-participant devnet anything above zero means the node is not isolated.

panels.title: Execution throughput (Mgas/s)
panels.description: chain_mgasps - geth's own mega-gas-per-second gauge, confirmed against the live scrape of this stand (the earlier guessed counter name did not exist).

panels.title: Beacon head slot
panels.description: Lighthouse beacon head slot (beacon_head_slot). On the 12-second devnet this should climb one slot every 12 s; a flat line means the chain has stalled.
